summary: Lists modules for running commands on Windows when no module fits: win_shell, win_command, raw and script. raw and script don't support become, async, or environment variables.
questions: How do I run an arbitrary command on Windows when there's no module for it?
Does the raw module support become on Windows?
Can I run a local script on Windows hosts with Ansible?
What's the difference between raw, script, win_command and win_shell?

answer_card.title: Running commands on Windows hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
- **`raw`**: runs a PowerShell command directly with no Ansible wrapper; `become`, `async`, and environment variables don't work.
- **`script`**: runs a script from the control node on the host; also no `become`, `async`, or env vars.
- **`win_command`**: runs an executable or batch file.
- **`win_shell`**: runs commands inside a shell.
